integrity: The two included verification programs are reproducible. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Infinite-family theorem for fan graphs with at least four path vertices; finite code corroborates but is not a proof. Prior fan orientation count, chordal flip connectivity, zonotope correspondence and small complete-split instances are credited. Historical equivalent work may exist under alternative terms.
title: Degree enumerator and connected simple stratum of fan graphical zonotopes
